title: EHR Content Formats V1.5
description: Enumerates supported EHR content formats. Uses oneOf with const+description so each value is self-documented.

oneOf.description: HL7 FHIR resources serialized in JSON.
HL7 FHIR resources serialized in XML.
HL7 Clinical Document Architecture (CDA) in XML.
Continuity of Care Document (CCD) in XML (a CDA-based profile).
openEHR composition/operational templates serialized in JSON.
openEHR composition/operational templates serialized in XML.
DICOM Structured Reporting objects (imaging-derived clinical content).
Portable Document Format; typically encapsulated narrative or scanned records.
Comma-Separated Values used for tabular EHR extracts.
Tab-Separated Values used for tabular EHR extracts.
Proprietary EHR exchange format defined by the implementation.
